issue.title: sase-telegram tests patch removed sase.project_display_names._project_display_name_map_cached
issue.description:
Proposed by phase beads sase-1tz.3.1.6 (tg_transport, note #1) and sase-1tz.3.1.7 (tg_degraded, note #2) of epic sase-1tz.3.1; filed by the sase-1tz.3.1 land agent.

`tests/test_formatting.py:169` and `tests/test_inbound.py:2878` in sase-telegram monkeypatch `sase.project_display_names._project_display_name_map_cached`. sase commit 19f497f82d ("refactor(project-display): split project_display_names into private modules") removed that name from the facade. Four tests ERROR at setup against current sase master: `TestBuildForkCopyText::test_tag_prompt_renders_tag_form` and three `TestBeadProjectContext` tests. As a result, sase-telegram's `sase tool run check` stays red (817 and then 876 passed, plus these 4 errors). Both phases reproduced the errors identically on the clean sase-telegram base with git stash.

Fix: retarget the patches at the equivalent seam in the split modules, or better at a public seam. The name cache now lives in `sase._project_display_cache` (`_PROJECT_DISPLAY_NAME_CACHE`, `_cached_projects_root_key`), which has no `_project_display_name_map_cached` function, so pick the seam deliberately. Then rerun `sase tool run check` from the sase-telegram checkout.
